snippet.title: NONHUMANS — Official Trailer | (eng)
snippet.description:
Shape public opinion, control the narrative, and win!

NONHUMANS is a political simulation game in which you lead the propaganda efforts of a fictional nation. Every action you take changes what people believe.

▸ Create news stories, control the media, and inspire your soldiers
▸ Find a way forward for your country
▸ Don’t let your opponents derail your plans
▸ Multiple endings depending on your decisions

Platforms: PC (Steam, itch.io)

All events and characters are fictional.

#nonhumans #indie #simulator
